scope: Manual whole-passage comparison with the bundled public-domain Douay–Rheims text and USCCB modern Catholic Bible. This checks text identity, not current England and Wales Lectionary assignment or authorised liturgical use. No modern Scripture text is stored.

passages.note: Modern 1:3 combines fidelity and charity, covered by native 1:2-3. The selected 2:1-8 narrative corresponds as a whole. Whole native verses are retained; this is not word-for-word equivalence.
Modern 7:9-14 spans native 7:9-17. The chapter 6 journey and chapter 8 marriage prayer also differ in content. A chapter/verse shift cannot supply an equivalent complete selection.

The healing narrative changes verse divisions. Modern 11:16-17 describes Tobit meeting Sarah outside the city; native 11:18 places her arrival later. A contiguous native range would add unrelated material and still omit source content.

The wages, exhortation, revelation and departure correspond across the selected whole passage. Details move within 12:12-14, all included in the selected continuous 5-15 range. This does not authorise identity fallback for individual Tobit verses.

Native 13:2,6-10 is a related canticle, but not a complete equivalent of modern 13:2,6-8. Modern 13:6 includes material absent from the native selection. The commented TVTMS row alone cannot verify this conversion.
Native 13:2-10 is a related canticle with different divisions and content, not a verified complete equivalent of modern 13:2-8.
